title: Matt Mullenweg says EmDash, while open source, is designed "to sell more Cloudflare services" and lacks the cross-platform democratization of WordPress (Matt Mullenweg)
summary: Matt Mullenweg: Matt Mullenweg says EmDash, while open source, is designed “to sell more Cloudflare services” and lacks the cross-platform democratization of WordPress — So, two other Matts at Cloudflare announced EmDash — the spiritual successor to WordPress that solves plugin security.
contentText:
Matt Mullenweg :

Automattic CEO Matt Mullenweg says EmDash, while open source, is designed “to sell more Cloudflare services” and lacks WordPress' cross-platform democratization   —  So, two other Matts at Cloudflare announced EmDash — the spiritual successor to WordPress that solves plugin security.
